_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. One should-trigger case per mode (review / unboxing / try-on / tutorial), and negatives that must route elsewhere: generating-images (stills), generating-product-photos (product stills), generating-videos (non-creator motion), and generating-audio (voiceover alone).
